## Description

One of the two algae of the OECD 201 toxicity test. In nature it forms coenobia of 4 cells in a row;
the laboratory strain almost always grows as single oval cells of 7–15 × 3–12 µm and 60–80 µm³.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 10 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

Single cells reproducing by autospores; thickness set to match the measured volume.

## Literature

- OECD (2011) Test No. 201: Freshwater alga and cyanobacteria, growth inhibition test, annex 2:
  1.2–1.5/day in OECD medium at ~70 µE m⁻² s⁻¹ and 21 °C (*D. subspicatus* SAG 86.81).

## Not implemented yet

- No coenobia (4-cell colonies) and no grazer-induced coloniality.
- No reagents on eukaryotes yet, so the OECD EC50 test cannot be run (roadmap E).

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares autospores with *Chlorella* and *Raphidocelis*.
